stages.title: LAYERED SOCIETY, NOT A COURT-PEASANT BINARY

pills.text: LAYERED SOCIETY, NOT A COURT-PEASANT BINARY
HIERARCHY AND MOBILITY COEXIST; BERNIER'S BINARY IS INADEQUATE.

sequence: TOP → emperor/princes/nobles
LOCAL POWER → rajas/zamindars
MIDDLE → merchants + clerks + professionals + master artisans + lower service
RURAL → khud-kasht + raiyati/muzarian + pahi-kasht + labour/service groups
AXES → rank + caste/jati + lineage + religion + gender + locality + slavery
